description.value: The Abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
The Corvinarus Abomination can long jump is up to 30 ft. and high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.
When the Corvinarus Abomination reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can use a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.
The Corvinarus Abomination makes three attacks, one with its Bite, one with its Claw, and one with its Swipe.
The Corvinarus Abomination leaps horizontally up to 30 feet or vertically up to 15 feet.

Darius is trapped in the center of the Planar Conduit.

Damage dealt to the Fey Crystal Tether is shared, dealing half damage to the crystal and half damage to the Abomination as lightning damage.

Damage dealt to the Shadow Crystal Tether is shared, dealing half damage to the crystal and half damage to the Abomination as lightning damage.

Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing 3 (1d6) lighting, and 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

The Abomination may only use this ability if the Fey Crystal Tether remains active.

The abomination rakes at you with a viciously taloned limb suffused with radiant electricity.

Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

The abomination attempts a vicious bite with a malformed maw of razor-sharp teeth.

Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage.

The Abomination only uses this ability if the Fey Crystal Tether has been destroyed.

The abomination rakes at you with a viciously taloned limb.

Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

The Abomination may only use this ability if the Shadow Crystal Tether has been destroyed.

The abomination swipes at you with a malformed limb of twisted muscle.
The abomination makes an attack with either its Claw or its Swipe.
If the Abomination fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

The Corvinarus Abomination can make 3 legendary actions.

  • Leap - 1 action

  • Attack - 1 action

  • Roar - 2 actions

The abomination emits a horrific scream drawn from the depths of its malformed chest.

Each creature within a 30 foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw or be Stunned until the end of their next turn.

When the abomination is targeted by a melee attack made from within 5 feet of it, it can attempt to embrace the blow and grasp the attacker with its tentacled forearm.

Perform an [[/check skill=ath]] check contested by the target's Athletics or [[/check skill=acr]]. On a success the attacker is grappled.

Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning 3 (1d6) lighting, and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

The Abomination may only use this ability if the Shadow Crystal Tether remains active.

The abomination swipes at you with a malformed limb of twisted muscle, suffused with necrotic electricity.
